title: STPU contract workers demonstrate in Brazzaville over unpaid wages and severance
location: Brazzaville, in front of the transport-workers union headquarters
scope: A reported demonstration during the STPU contract workers' strike; the strike affected services in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire, but no separate demonstration in Pointe-Noire is established.
organizer: STPU contract workers and their union section; the article quotes section secretary Romain Bamana.
threshold_50_evidence: ACI explicitly reports workers demonstrating on 18 October but gives no demonstrator count. Its 450-family figure describes economic impact, not participants; the ≥50 threshold is unresolved.

start_date.summary: ACI published 19 October and says the strike was intensified by a demonstration on 18 October.

location.summary: ACI places the demonstration in Brazzaville in front of the public-transport union headquarters.

organizer.summary: The report attributes the action to STPU contract workers and quotes the STPU union section secretary.

demands.summary: Workers sought payment of nine months of 2024 salary arrears and collective-layoff entitlements; the union also asked the President to resolve the dispute.

participants_original.summary: The report gives no estimate of demonstrators; 450 affected families is not an attendance figure.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Demonstration is explicit but no simultaneous participant count is reported.

protester_violence.summary: The source does not describe protester violence; value remains unknown.

state_response.summary: No event-specific state response is described in this account.

notes: Keep this 18 Oct public demonstration separate from the strike onset (7 Oct), which the source reports without documenting an earlier public gathering. Do not use the 450 affected-families count as turnout.
open_questions: Was the 18 October demonstration attended by at least 50 people at one time?
Was there an event end or additional demonstrative action after 18 October?
Did a separate public event occur in Pointe-Noire, or does that city appear only as a service-impact location?
Did the source syndicate elsewhere? No direct written-origin link is documented.

title: Dolisie municipal staff intersyndical general assembly over accumulated wage arrears
location: Dolisie, Niari Department; specific venue unknown
scope: An intersyndical general assembly reported as actual on 10 October; the report does not say whether it was an open public protest rather than an internal labor meeting.
threshold_50_evidence: ACI confirms a general assembly but gives no attendance count and does not characterize it as a public street demonstration; threshold and public character remain unresolved.

start_date.summary: ACI states the assembly took place on 10 October in Dolisie.

location.summary: The report names Dolisie; the meeting venue is not specified.

organizer.summary: ACI attributes the meeting to the Dolisie municipal staff intersyndical.

demands.summary: Municipal workers cited 76 months of wage arrears and said a prior charge sheet had not received a satisfactory response.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Meeting occurrence is reported, but neither public character nor 50 simultaneous participants is established.

state_response.summary: The prior lack of a satisfactory response is described; no response at the 10 October meeting is established.

notes: The article also announces an indefinite strike scheduled from 14 October and a proposed city closure; neither scheduled action is treated as executed on this source alone.
open_questions: Was this a public-facing protest or a union/workplace assembly?
Did the strike actually begin on 14 October, and did it include a public gathering?
Which authority received or was expected to act on the salary claim?
Was there a distinct post-assembly gathering or city closure?
